newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside says Samsung awarded contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside says Samsung awarded contract.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Pty Ltd said on Thursday it had awarded the first major contract for the development of the Laminaria and Corallina Oilfields in the Timor Sea to Korea's Samsung Heavy Industries Co Ltd.

Samsung will commence design of a 1.4 million barrel floating production storage and offloading (FPSO) barge at its fabrication yard on the island of Koji, 40 kilometres from the Korean port of Pusan, Woodside said in a statement.
Woodside did not release the value of the contract.

Full approval for the development of the fields by regulatory authoritories and the AC/P8 joint venture participants was expected by the end of the year with production commencing in early 1999, the company said.
The linked Laminaria and Corallina developments have been estimated by Woodside to cost a total of A$900 million.
AC/P8 partners are Woodside with 50 percent and the Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd and Royal Dutch/Shell Group with 25 percent each.
